component.name: TeddyBench
component.summary: Manage Toniebox SD cards and create custom tonies

developer.name: Dane Leube, based on TeddyBench by Team RevvoX

description.p: TeddyBench shows the tonie files on the SD card of your Toniebox, creates custom tonies from MP3 or Ogg files, exports and plays their audio and assigns them to NFC tags.
An optional Proxmark3 or PN5180 based NFC reader can read the UID of a tag, which is then used automatically.
